name: Vremja umirat'
source:
The main character is dead. She does not understand who killed her and why. A mysterious voice gives the poor man a chance to find the culprits and take revenge. The heroine comes face to face with her own family, whose members, however, are in no hurry to answer questions.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2660]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
主角已经死了。她不知道是谁杀了自己，也不明白原因。一个神秘的声音给了她机会，让她找出凶手并复仇。女主角直面自己的家人，但他们似乎并不急着回答她的问题。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2660]Anivisual[/url]]
